source.base_subject: docs: record NVFP4 M32 asymmetric E4M3 rejection

profile_priority.caveat: the b09614c profile predates later production changes including exact-M32 gate/up raw-weight cp.async; it establishes that GDN was material but is not a current-HEAD ranking
profile_priority.selection_reason: exact-C32 extends the already successful register-state lifetime across the existing two-M16 C32 boundary and is materially different from the rejected shared-resident, table-free, half-tile, pair-CTA, and shared-pipeline mechanisms

candidate.baseline: two ordered production-equivalent exact-M16 register-state launches
implementation: template the private register-state arithmetic body on a compile-time token count of 16 or 32
retain per-token BF16x2 encoding and decoding of every recurrent-state word
load state once before token 0 and write it once after token 31
leave the public kGdnMaximumTileTokenCount=16 contract, production dispatcher, runner, and every non-C32 path unchanged
candidate.dependency_audit: for a future production C32 route, conv16(first) then conv16(second) may precede GDN32 because causal-convolution history and output do not depend on GDN state; the candidate still requires direct runner-level proof before promotion
candidate.semantic_boundary: the removed token-15 global store and token-16 global load carry the same already-rounded BF16 bits held in packed register words; no token-boundary rounding was removed

correctness: all 32-token BF16 outputs bitwise equal to two ordered exact-M16 launches
final BF16 recurrent state bitwise equal
disjoint input state and all five non-state inputs preserved
single 48x256 CUDA Graph kernel for the candidate and zero nodes for invalid non-M32 capture
frozen_gates.resources: same envelope as M16: 64 registers/thread, 34056 static shared bytes, zero local bytes, and four active CTAs/SM

performance.stop_loss: failure skips runner integration, model oracle, NCU, Nsys, end-to-end, and replication

sass.interpretation: the compile-time M32 loop bound does not expand the loop body or change the resource envelope

performance_protocol.fixture: deterministic finite BF16 GDN inputs and a 36 MiB rotating recurrent-state pool

decision.reason: the candidate is bitwise exact, preserves the M16 resource envelope, and improves all six fixed-clock rounds, but its 1.02474x paired median misses the frozen 1.03x early gate
decision.restoration_rule: reconsider only with a materially different mechanism or a revised system-level objective established before measurement; do not restore by lowering this frozen gate after the result

cleanup.method: save the complete candidate patch and binary evidence, then reverse the candidate through apply_patch

artifacts.role: candidate fixed-clock correctness and performance log

limitations: Performance evidence is from one fixed-clock Jetson AGX Orin and one retained process.
The fixture uses deterministic finite BF16 GDN inputs and rotating synthetic recurrent states rather than checkpoint-derived hidden trajectories.
The candidate was screened as a direct GDN logical C32 operation; the runner-level two-conv16 then GDN32 ordering was not implemented after the early gate failed.
The historical post-GDN-M16 profile predates later production optimizations and must be refreshed before selecting another hotspot from its ordering.
Stop-loss intentionally omitted NCU, Nsys, model-oracle, end-to-end, and multi-process evidence, so no whole-model or dynamic-stall claim is made.
The rejection applies only to exact-C32 lifetime extension of the existing register-state body under the frozen 1.03x/1.00x gates.

next_priority.ranking_rule: use Prefill marginal union exposure and Decode raw/union time, not stale raw gate/up sums
next_priority.generic_double_or_triple_buffering: still deferred because the last measured Decode span idle was only 0.733879 percent and the existing narrow Prefill gate/up overlap already consumes the proven independent work
